messages:
Elena Morales: Welcome aboard! Quick logistics for your first week (I-9, background check intake, badge pickup, benefits). TL;DR schedule below.

Alex Chen: Thanks! Can we confirm an I-9 kiosk time? I'm hybrid and will be in the SF office on Wed.

Elena Morales: @Alex Chen — we've penciled you in for badge pickup + I-9 kiosk at 10:30 AM on Wed at the lobby security desk. Please bring two forms of ID (passport OR driver’s license + Social Security card). If you're remote, use the remote verification flow (link below).

IT Provisioning Bot: New hire provisioning ticket created: PROV-5421. Samir Patel assigned.

Samir Patel: I'll confirm laptop + Slack/Gsuite access. @Alex Chen expect an invite to pick a delivery window or in-office pickup.

Michelle Ortiz: Hi Alex — I’m your onboarding buddy for week 1. Lunch Friday?

Elena Morales: Background check (SecureScreen) — you should have an email to complete intake. If not, reply here and I'll trigger a resend.

Alex Chen: Got the BGC email. What's the benefits enrollment window?

Elena Morales: Benefits enrollment opens on Day 3. You have 30 days from that date to enroll in medical/dental and elect 401(k) deferral for the company match. You'll receive a BenefitsPortal email with step-by-step.

Elena Morales: Quick checklist for new-hires:
1) Complete I-9 in-person or via remote vendor within 3 business days.
2) Finish background check consent.
3) Upload voided check for payroll/direct deposit.
4) Enroll in benefits by Day 33 to avoid missing open enrollment.
5) Set up MFA and company SSO.
6) Read the employee handbook (link in new-hire packet).

Alex Chen: For remote I-9, what's the vendor link? I can't find the email from them.

Elena Morales: Remote I-9: https://onboard.redwood/hr/i9-remote — also in your new-hire packet. Use code RW-ONB-2026 at the kiosk. Example steps we send the vendor: 

```
# Remote I-9 quick steps
1) visit https://onboard.redwood/hr/remote-kiosk
2) enter code: RW-ONB-2026
3) choose 'virtual verification' and schedule a 15-min slot
```

Alex Chen: Great, thanks. One more — where do I sign W-4 and set up direct deposit?

Elena Morales: W-4 and direct deposit are in HRIS -> Payroll -> Forms. Upload a voided check (PDF) or bank letter for DD. If you'd rather bring a physical check on day 1 we can take it at the HR desk.

Michelle Ortiz: FYI team lunch Friday @12:00 on 6th-floor kitchen. We'll do a short 12:15–12:45 intro.

Jamal Reed: Quick manager note — Day 1 schedule: 9:30–10:00 sync with me, 10:00–11:30 company orientation, 1:00–2:00 product overview. I'll send calendar invites.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone! One last q — do I already have badge access to the 3rd-floor lab?

Elena Morales: Lab access requires manager approval. Reply with manager approval or I can queue it once @Jamal Reed confirms.

Jamal Reed: approved :white_check_mark: — Alex, you're good for lab access.

Elena Morales: All set — if anything blocks you before Wed reply here or DM me. :party_parrot:
